_comment: Written by dragon-dev-buddy:buddy-setup on 2026-07-31. Re-run that skill when the project, stack or threat profile changes. Safe to commit: no secrets, and the engagement block references only self-owned infrastructure. Note: the live_url is a PRODUCTION instance — prefer non-destructive checks against it.

project.name: waggle
project.what_it_is: Placement oracle and ledger for Proxmox infrastructure — authoritative source of truth for VM placement state across hypervisors. Does not provision VMs itself; companion River workers and the Terraform provider do that.
project.runtime: Docker container image (ghcr.io), split serve/worker processes
project.deploy_target: GitHub Actions docker-publish to ghcr.io; live at https://waggle.glueopshosted.rocks

security.auth_model: JWT bearer tokens + API keys; multi-tenant orgs with isolated per-tenant encrypted databases; two-tier KEK->DEK envelope encryption; session tracking and an auth-event audit trail
trust_boundaries: anonymous internet -> API (public surface: health, auth/signup)
API -> per-tenant encrypted databases (tenant isolation boundary)
API -> River job queue -> provisioning workers
waggle / workers -> Proxmox hypervisors (the fleet it commands)
KEK -> DEK envelope encryption / key custody
known_risk_areas: No SAST / SCA / secret-scanning in CI yet
Two-tier KEK->DEK envelope encryption — verify key custody, rotation, and that DEKs are never logged or returned
Multi-tenant isolation is a core property — verify no cross-tenant path via id-addressed org/tenant/pool/slot resources (IDOR)
Placement oracle commands a real hypervisor fleet — integrity of placement decisions is a security property, not just correctness

engagement._comment: Self-owned infrastructure. Owner authorized testing against the live instance during setup. Not a client engagement.
engagement.authorization_ref: self-owned; owner authorized live-instance testing in setup 2026-07-31

practice.dev_command: mprocs (go run . serve | go run . worker | yarn dev)

skill_level: Experienced Go / platform engineer building out the appsec practice; wants SOC 2 / GDPR / CCPA readiness
